kpis.description_fr: Revenus consommables de séquençage (kits, réactifs). Récurrent, basé sur le parc installé de séquenceurs NGS Illumina. KPI clé du modèle razor/razor-blade.
kpis.description_en: Sequencing consumables revenue (kits, reagents). Recurring, based on installed base of Illumina NGS sequencers. Key KPI of razor/razor-blade business model.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes de séquenceurs NGS (NovaSeq X, NextSeq 1000/2000, MiSeq i100). Cyclique. Forte baisse FY24 (clients en attente transition NovaSeq X).
kpis.description_en: NGS sequencer sales (NovaSeq X, NextSeq 1000/2000, MiSeq i100). Cyclical. Sharp FY24 decline (customers awaiting NovaSeq X transition).

kpis.description_fr: Revenus du segment Core Illumina (hors GRAIL spin-off 2024). Référence post-spin-off. 91% du CA total.
kpis.description_en: Core Illumina segment revenue (excluding GRAIL post 2024 spin-off). Post-spin-off reference. 91% of total sales.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus du segment GRAIL (test sang multi-cancer Galleri). Spin-off finalisé en juin 2024. Disparaît du périmètre Illumina en 2025.
kpis.description_en: GRAIL segment revenue (multi-cancer blood test Galleri). Spin-off finalized June 2024. Removed from Illumina perimeter in 2025.

notes: FY=calendar year (ending Sunday end of December). GRAIL divested mid-2024.
